manifest._readme: Every file of the Hugging Face repository MekaHime/MekaHime_Amika at the revision scripts/setup_tts.py pins (VOICE_REV): [size in bytes, SHA-256]. Her voice is every file outside live2d/ (it goes to vendor/tts-engine/Speakers/MekaHime_Amika/), her Live2D model is live2d/Amika/ (it goes to avatar/models/Amika/). setup_tts.py downloads them file by file and checks each one against this list. A new revision of the repository needs a new list (setup_tts.py --write-manifest <folder>) together with a new VOICE_REV. The paper doll (live2d/Host/) has its own block below, pinned at PAPER_DOLL_REV.

paper_doll._readme: The paper doll that stands in for her helpers on the Use page: live2d/Host/ of the same repository, [size in bytes, SHA-256] of each of its files. setup_tts.py installs it into avatar/models/Host/ from the revision PAPER_DOLL_REV names (not the revision above): while that is empty, nothing is downloaded. --write-manifest fills this block from a copy that holds live2d/Host/ and keeps it otherwise.
